body:
## Problem

`sendMessageWeixin` and `sendMessageItemWeixin` only log on **failure** (`logger.error`). A successful text send leaves **no log line at the default INFO level** — the only send-related lines are DEBUG-level request/response dumps and ERROR failures.

Media sends (`sendMediaItems`) already log a success line (`logger.info(`${label}: success to=...`)`), but the text path — the most common one — is silent.

**Impact:** when a user reports a missing outbound message, it is impossible to verify from logs whether the message was actually handed to the Weixin API. During a recent incident investigation, the absence of any send log line at INFO level made it look like the send never happened (a false positive), even though the message was delivered.

## Fix

Add an INFO success line to both text send paths, mirroring the existing `sendMediaItems` success log, including the server-assigned `message_id` when present:

```
sendMessageWeixin: success to=<user> clientId=<id> serverMessageId=<id|none>
sendMessageItemWeixin: success to=<user> clientId=<id> serverMessageId=<id|none>
```

## Tests

3 new cases in `src/messaging/send.test.ts`:
- success log includes server `message_id`
- success log shows `serverMessageId=(none)` when the server omits it
- item-send path logs success

Full suite: 463 passed. `tsc --noEmit` clean.
title: fix(send): log outbound text sends at INFO level for delivery verification
